title: Playboy Magazine October 1986 - Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The Playboy Magazine October 1986 issue is a vintage collectible featuring content related to art & photography, men's interests, and modeling. This specific edition includes the centerfold, making it a sought-after item for collectors of retro magazines. The publication, originating from the United States, is in English and was released monthly, reflecting the cultural and societal trends of the time. This magazine provides a nostalgic glimpse into the fashion, entertainment, and lifestyle of the 1980s, making it a valuable addition to any magazine collection.
